title: Unprofessional · adj.
subtitle: 「不專業／不合職場規範／失禮／不具商務作風」，究竟是哪一種 unprofessional？
description: 「不專業／不合職場規範／失禮／不具商務作風」，究竟是哪一種 unprofessional？

words.meaning: 在工作場合不恰當的；不合職場規範的
words.note: 使用者提供。inappropriate at work 是 unprofessional 最透明的解釋性改寫，表示某行為、言語、衣著或做法在職場環境下不合宜。它比 discourteous 更廣，也比 not businesslike 更直接點出 workplace norms。
words.example: Making personal remarks about colleagues is inappropriate at work.

exercises.original: Sharing confidential gossip about colleagues is unprofessional.
exercises.zh: 散播同事的機密八卦是不合職場規範的。
exercises.upgrade: inappropriate at work · 在工作場合不恰當的；不合職場規範的

options.explanation: the issue is a workplace norm violation rather than merely poor manners.
強調缺乏禮貌、尊重與基本禮節。 本題的決定性線索是 behaviour that is unsuitable in a workplace；這裡需要的是「不符合職場規範」。因此 discourteous 雖與 unprofessional 有重疊，但究竟是禮貌、職場適宜性、商務作風、程序規範或角色尊嚴並不最吻合。

強調內容、外觀或行為不適合在工作場所出現。 本題的決定性線索是 behaviour that is unsuitable in a workplace；這裡需要的是「不符合職場規範」。因此 unsuitable for the workplace 雖與 unprofessional 有重疊，但究竟是禮貌、職場適宜性、商務作風、程序規範或角色尊嚴並不最吻合。
強調行為有失某職位／身份應有的尊嚴或標準。 本題的決定性線索是 behaviour that is unsuitable in a workplace；這裡需要的是「不符合職場規範」。因此 unbecoming 雖與 unprofessional 有重疊，但究竟是禮貌、職場適宜性、商務作風、程序規範或角色尊嚴並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 不禮貌的；失禮的；無禮的
words.note: 使用者提供。discourteous 是較正式的詞，強調缺乏禮貌、尊重或基本禮節。它可描述 unprofessional 的其中一個具體面向，但不涵蓋能力不足、衣著不當或不可靠等其他問題。
words.example: It was discourteous to interrupt the client repeatedly.

words.meaning: 不具商務作風的；不夠專業俐落的
words.note: 使用者提供。not businesslike 表示做事方式、溝通、外觀或安排不夠有條理、務實、正式或符合商務場合期待。它比 unprofessional 更偏 style and manner，而不是道德／禮貌判斷。
words.example: The presentation was friendly but not businesslike.

falseSynonyms.zh: inappropriate at work 是透明解釋；unprofessional 更自然、更精簡，也可涵蓋能力、可靠性與形象問題。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The joke was inappropriate at work. His conduct was unprofessional.

falseSynonyms.zh: discourteous 只表示失禮／不尊重；一件事可以 unprofessional 而並不無禮，例如文件格式混亂。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The reply was discourteous. The report looked unprofessional.

falseSynonyms.zh: not businesslike 強調做事方式、外觀或流程不夠商務化；unprofessional 範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The letter was not businesslike. Mocking a colleague was unprofessional.

falseSynonyms.zh: improper 更正式，也可涉及程序、道德或規則違反；unprofessional 更聚焦專業／職場標準。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The payment was improper. His workplace conduct was unprofessional.

falseSynonyms.zh: incompetent 指能力不足；unprofessional 可以是態度、衣著、語氣或禮貌問題，未必代表能力差。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The technician was incompetent. The technician's rude email was unprofessional.

falseSynonyms.zh: casual 只表示隨意，不一定負面；某些工作環境本來就允許 casual dress 或語氣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The office has a casual dress code. His behaviour was unprofessional.

falseSynonyms.zh: unethical 表示違反道德原則，通常比 unprofessional 更嚴重；不專業未必不道德。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Falsifying records is unethical. Arriving badly prepared was unprofessional.

falseSynonyms.zh: professional 是相反方向的正面形容詞；不是近義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Her response was professional. His response was unprofessional.
